messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Had to move from where I was born/brought up just to be rid of the hassle!

output.original_text: Had to move from where I was born/brought up just to be rid of the hassle!
output.joy: I finally moved from where I was born and brought up, and it feels so liberating to be rid of that hassle!
output.sadness: I had to leave the place where I was born and grew up, all just to escape the hassle that surrounded me.
output.fear: I was terrified to move away from where I was born and brought up, but I had to do it to escape the constant hassle!
output.anger: I was forced to move from where I was born and raised just to be rid of the never-ending hassle!
output.surprise: I couldn't believe I had to move from where I was born and brought up just to finally be free of that hassle!
output.disgust: It disgusts me that I had to move from where I was born and raised just to escape the endless hassle!
